First off, this is the most stable game i have ever played. Considering i am using win11 and didn't crash once, that is amazing.

game:
story, felt incomplete, i finished the game and still have so many questions that i feel were never answered. if you played ME 1-3, this story branched off before 3 so was kind of weird since i had already played 3.

combat and customization seems considerable better, imo, then ME 1-3. with that said, i spent too much time scanning areas for no reason. Better than the area searches in ME1, planet scans in ME2, and system scans in ME3 though.
with that said, you can look at each planet in a system and there are "hidden" objects, but they are not hard to find at all. unless a quests requests something, they are completely not needed. just xp and possibly a few rss.

strike teams and cryo are nice add for rss. Multiplayer is added that you can use to get strike team rewards but not needed, as you strike teams can do them without you having to go into Multiplayer.
while i didn't play online much, there were not many people on. saw 2 people over like 5 hours.
